May run as root (runAsNonRoot not true or runAsUser 0)

validators_initial.name: kube-linter
issues: no-read-only-root-fs: Deployment/bg-collector: container "collector" does not have a read-only root file system
run-as-non-root: Deployment/bg-collector: container "collector" is not set to runAsNonRoot
unset-cpu-requirements: Deployment/bg-collector: container "collector" has cpu request 0
unset-memory-requirements: Deployment/bg-collector: container "collector" has memory limit 0

attempts.rationale: Added automountServiceAccountToken false, set runAsNonRoot true with non-zero UID, dropped privileges, set allowPrivilegeEscalation false, readOnlyRootFilesystem true, added CPU/Memory limits and requests, kept hostPath volume as required for functionality.
attempts.proposed_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: bg-collector
  namespace: bg-runtime
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: bg-collector
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: bg-collector
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: collector
          image: busybox:1.36.1
          command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - |
              while true; do
                if grep -q BG_SENTINEL /data/app.log 2>/dev/null; then echo COLLECTED; else echo NOTHING_TO_COLLECT; fi
                sleep 2
              done
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          volumeMounts:
            - name: hostlogs
              mountPath: /data
              readOnly: true
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 32Mi
      volumes:
        - name: hostlogs
          hostPath:
            path: /var/bg-demo
            type: DirectoryOrCreate

drifts.detail: hostPath volume 'hostlogs' (/var/bg-demo) was replaced by emptyDir: the workload no longer sees the host files it was mounted to read or write
service account token is no longer mounted: breaks the app if it calls the Kubernetes API
now runs as non-root (runAsUser 1000): the image must support that user
root filesystem is read-only and no writable volume is mounted: apps that write temp/log/cache files will crash
resource limits added: too-low values cause OOMKills or CPU throttling

intent.note: A security-clean patch changed what the workload does. Review before proposing.
